description: This file implements the basic functions for a SLAP (Service Logic Aggregation Plane) Loam Broker Object, including its creation, removal, object enrollment, and initialization. It defines functions for object lifecycle management and sets up internal components such as communication interfaces and locks.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE SlapLboCreate(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
methods.description: Constructs a new Slap Loam Broker Object, initializes its member variables and functions, and links it to the container and owner contexts.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapLboRemove(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Destroys the specified Slap Loam Broker Object, freeing resources and cleanup.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapLboEnrollObjects(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Enrolls required subordinate objects and interfaces, such as communication interfaces, for the Loam Broker object.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS SlapLboInitialize(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Initializes the Loam Broker Object's member fields, sets default properties, and prepares it for operation.
